title: Create a short link with an SSRF-safe target and a cryptographically random code

scope_out: Custom or vanity codes (SG-1); Editing a link's target after creation (SG-2); Following redirect chains or resolving hostnames to validate them (SG-10)

entities.name: Create a short link with an SSRF-safe target and a cryptographically random code

operations.text:
1. Extend `backend/src/types/models.py` — add `Link`, `CreateLinkRequest`, `LinkView`.
2. Extend `backend/src/config/settings.py` — add `PUBLIC_BASE_URL`.
3. Create `backend/src/repository/link_repository.py` — insert link, unique-code collision handling.
4. Create `backend/src/services/target_validation.py` — `validate_target(url, public_base_url)`; literal scheme/host/IP-range checks only.
5. Create `backend/src/services/code_generator.py` — `generate_code()` via `secrets`, 62-char alphabet, >=7 chars.
6. Create `backend/src/services/link_service.py` — `create_link(owner_id, target_url)`.
7. Create `backend/src/api/links.py` — `POST /links`; requires `require_session`.
8. Create `frontend/src/app/api/links/route.ts` — `POST` handler proxying to backend.
9. Add `backend/tests/unit/test_target_validation.py`, `backend/tests/unit/test_code_generator.py`, `backend/tests/integration/test_links_api.py` covering AC1–AC5.
